notablePrerequisites: You control at least four artifacts.
description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers.
Holding priority, activate Megatog by sacrificing an artifact, giving it +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat step 2 three additional times.
Activate Atogatog by sacrificing Megatog, giving Atogatog +15/+15 until end of turn.
Resolve the Mayael's Aria trigger, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain ten life, and win the game.
